title: Fence canonical retained-row identities in the scan projection cut when map keys differ
outcome: A retained row whose map key differs from summary.run_id cannot produce a stale prepared scan summary.
acceptance: A deterministic re-keyed retained-row case either expands the cut to the canonical identity or forces live fallback.
Unstamped canonical-identity marker changes are fenced, while ordinary well-formed retained rows preserve their behavior.
